decision_threshold_note: F1-optimal cut-off selected on the last 20 % of the training timeline; the test set was not used to pick it. Inference treats score >= decision_threshold as 'irrigation recommended'.
training_feature_ranges_note: min/max per feature over the training split. Inference treats a request with any reading outside these bounds as rule_fallback_out_of_range: the model score is still computed and quoted in the reason, but the crop threshold rule makes the decision. See docs/limitations.md.

classes.0: irrigation not required / no irrigation event

label_meaning: irrigation_event = 1 when an irrigation action started at this reading, 0 otherwise. It is a historical label and is never used as a model input.
limitations: The bundled training CSV is SYNTHETIC prototype data, not real field data.
Prediction scores are uncalibrated logistic outputs, not a guaranteed probability of being correct.

Historical features need sequential ESP32 readings. Without them the model falls back to neutral placeholders and its recall goes to 1.00 while precision collapses - it then recommends water far too often (see test_metrics_without_history).
Only the crops with an indicator column (crop_is_*) are validated. A request for any other crop produces all-zero crop indicators and the response is flagged as extrapolation.

The label depends on the simulator's hidden true moisture and its hidden per-plot wind factor, which the sensors never observe, so a perfect separation of the classes is not achievable from these features.
